thread:
nina: Quick alignment thread for GA readiness checklist. We need owners for: SLA wording, public pricing caps, support rota, monitoring dashboards + runbooks, and a short AE one-pager. Target date: 2028-02-21. Please ack and call out blockers.
omar: SLA idea: 99.9% baseline for paid tiers, enterprise add-on 99.95. Include per-surface SLOs (generation vs embeddings). I'll draft precise language and a short appendix on how fallbacks affect availability accounting.
lucy: Docs & AE: I'll handle quickstarts (Py/JS) + one-pager for AE with canned responses. Also will add a short "what we throttle and why" snippet for customer-facing docs. ETA Tue EOD.
devops-bot: deploy-bot: Canary window scheduled 2028-02-19T06:00Z. Smoke: 120rps for 20m. Auto-rollback triggers: sustained error_rate >= 3% for 6m OR p95 latency > 700ms for 10m. Alerts to #launch-run and #launch-pager.
nina: Monitoring asks: 15s scrape for critical metrics first 72h, traces 14d, logs 21d. Alerts: token_error_rate > 0.4% sustained 5m, p95 gen latency > 180ms sustained 10m, cache_hit drop > 20% absolute. Need dashboard owner + runbook owner.
omar: I'll own SLA text + runbook annex for rollback procedure. Rollback sequence: soft-fallback -> reduce max_tokens for new sessions -> quantized small model -> reject new sessions (429) if unresolved. Will PR the text.
lucy: I'll own docs + AE one-pager and a short migration note for Dedicated customers. Also adding an internal FAQ for CS: top 10 questions + canned replies.
sales-bot: sales-notify: prepping AE price sheet. Need final RU bands from FinOps before we publish public page. Recommend we stage Hobby/Team numbers and keep Enterprise "contact us" until contracts are ready.
nina: Open risks: burst autoscale billing, silent quality regressions post-quantization, docs lag on SDKs. Actions: Omar -> SLA + rollback annex; Lucy -> docs + AE sheet; Nina -> launch comms + legal checklist; FinOps -> RU bands. Confirm by EOD Thu.
omar: Action: creating PR with example fallback config block and sample credit calc. Example snippet I'll include in PR:
```yaml
fallback_policy:
  - condition: error_rate > 0.03
    action: downgrade_to: model-small-q8
    new_session_max_tokens: 200
  - condition: sustained_errors > 6m
    action: deny_new_sessions: true
```
PR: https://git.internal/sla/pull/6123
lucy: I'll stage docs at /docs/ga/ and open PR with quickstarts + AE one-pager. ETA Tue.
nina: ops note: set monitoring retention to 14d traces for launch project and enable budget alert at $800/day. Also create #launch-pager and pin the triage checklist.
sales-bot: AEs want a short script for early access customers explaining soft-quotas and burst surcharge. Lucy please include.
finops (via DM): will confirm RU bands by Wed noon. If delayed, we soft-launch with contact-sales for Enterprise.
nina: Thanks all. If no objections we lock defaults end-of-day Thu and schedule a dry-run Friday to exercise alerts/runbooks. Please ack.
omar: Ack. Posting SLA PR now.
lucy: Ack. Opening docs PR.
devops-bot: reminder: dry-run smoke test scheduled 2028-02-18T22:00Z (synthetic load 100rps 15m).
